title: EARLIER reads the outer row inside FILTER: running count of rows up to the current value
query: "RT Rows", COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( Sales, Sales[Quantity] <= EARLIER ( Sales[Quantity] ) ) ) )

source.quote: EARLIER evaluates a column in the outer row context, in case there -- are multiple row contexts open in the same expression
source.supports: the page shows this query shape (customers by yearly income) with its running total

derivation: Sales[Quantity] by row: 1, 2, 1, 5, 2, 3, 1. Distinct values 1, 2, 3, 5 with 3, 2, 1, 1 rows (CALCULATE turns the row into a filter). FILTER ( Sales, ... ) has no filter on Sales, so it scans all 7 rows and keeps those with a quantity up to the outer value: 3, 3 + 2 = 5, 5 + 1 = 6, 7.
